handoff.next_job: Check quote age first and do not enter on stale quotes (today's were about 879-949 minutes old). Read the SAN.PA and BAYN.DE reactions, EQNR.OL after the guidance cut, the chips/ASML reaction to the MATCH Act and Dutch opposition, gold after PCE and tariffs, Brent vs $98 with confirmed supply loss, and copper after the monthly drop. Record newly scored shadows (34 waiting) and update the ledger. Buy only on a primary-source, name-specific new catalyst whose expected move is well above twice entry cost, with honest confidence of 0.52 or more, and not into a falling index.

lessons.rule: Up calls made into the current falling market have all lost (7 cases): require a primary-source, name-specific, new catalyst and do not buy pre-open while the index driver is falling. This only tightens the catalyst test.
lessons.evidence: IFX.DE long stopped out -9.88%; shadows up wrong: BP.L -0.18%, STMPA.PA -2.38%, GSK.L -3.08%, EXH1.DE -5.55%, NOVN.SW -5.27%, IFX.DE -11.18%. Up tally 0/6, mean -4.61%. All from one sell-off regime (2026-11-10 to 11-24).

lessons.rule: Hypothesis (3 cases, does not change calls beyond the lesson above): up calls whose catalyst is an already-published or secondary-source company event lose money in a falling market.
lessons.evidence: IFX.DE long -9.88% (record quarter, guidance); shadow BP.L up 5d -0.18%; shadow STMPA.PA up 5d -2.38%.

lessons.rule: Down calls with a named sector or commodity catalyst in the current risk-off tape have worked (5 cases); this informs shadows only and never loosens rules (no shorts).
